title: 第十二章 临江仙
content_zh:
贾珩朝老者拱了拱手，道：「老先生请了。」
老者一身绸衫，头发灰白，精神颧硕，冲贾珩微微颔首致意，苍老目光中带着几分审视，问道：「公子是要出售书稿？」
贾珩笑了笑，道：「只是过来问问，老先生若不喜，只当在下是一时玩笑罢了。」
老者手捻颌下胡须，笑了笑，说道：「未知是何书稿，可否拿出一观？」
他家主人最喜欢这些演义画本，再三叮嘱于他，若有新的故事画本，一定拿给她看。
贾珩面色顿了下，略有些不好意思，道：「这个，我还未写出来。」
老者脸色就有些古怪，面色就有些不虞，作色道：「这位公子，莫非是在寻老朽消遣？」
贾珩道：「老先生海涵，书稿的确未写出，不过故事早已成竹在胸，老先生此间可有纸笔，稍待片刻，即刻书来一章，予老先生一观。」
老者见此，却是被贾珩这股认真的样子弄得一愣，不由失笑，说道：「公子还真是一位妙人。」
对着一旁的夥计吩咐道：「你去寻纸笔来。」
那夥计应了一声，连忙领命去了。
老者笑道：「老朽听过曹子建七步成诗，公子这是效古人之雅事了？」
这家翰墨斋一开始是背后东家为了方便搜集古书而开，他在此不过是看看书，却是很久没有遇到这样一个有趣的年轻人了。
贾珩笑了笑，道：「自不敢比古人之捷才，但方才的确未曾欺瞒老先生，余对这文稿已是成竹在胸。」
想想前世那些写网文的作者，一个小时几千字，真是下笔成文，洋洋洒洒。
不多时，夥计拿着纸笔而来。
这时，翰墨斋已三三两两来了一些购书的年轻士子，听到这边动静，就有围拢过来观看的道。
其中一个青衫直裰的公子，年岁约莫二十出头，面容儒雅，目光温润，手拿一把摺扇，腰间悬挂着玉佩，好奇地看着这一幕，对一旁身形魁梧，面相方阔的蓝袍青年，小声道：「文度兄，这位兄台，莫不是要做诗？不想这样的雅事，我们在这翰墨斋碰上了。」
这二人是神京国子监的监生，今日无课，就到了翰墨斋闲逛，准备买些笔墨纸砚。
这边厢，贾珩冲夥计道了一声谢，接过纸笔，在砚台中沾了墨水，摊开洁白如雪的纸张，道书写起来。

他本来想写射鵰，但射鵰言辞是后世大白话，恐于此间，难登大雅之堂，惹来非议，尤其见周方渐渐围聚了一些读书人，故而改写起了三国演义，三国演义半文不白，用词描写颇得经传史书之神韵。
「滚滚长江东逝水，浪花淘尽英雄……」
因此方世界，历史与前世华夏有一些不同，明朝杨慎倒也确有其人，前明嘉靖之时，同样有大礼仪之争。
但杨慎命运轨迹与前世不同，并未流配于云南，这首临江仙，就未出现过，当然，纵然出现过，引述他人之诗词于书中，也无可指摘之处。
但临江仙一出，正在围观的众人，见之无不惊讶。
「这阙临江仙，当真是慷慨悲壮，荡气回肠，似是新词？还有这字疏朗开阔，笔锋锐利，如刀剑斧钺，铁画银钩……当真是功力匪浅。」表字文度的青年，目光咄咄，看向一旁青衫公子，低声问道：「韩兄，你交游广阔，可认得这位兄台是何人？」
青衫公子摇了摇头，面色也有惊讶，低声道：「我看着也面生的紧，一会儿再问就是了。」
贾珩以行楷书写临江仙，笔锋流畅，倏而，临江仙书就之后，就开始写「天下大势，分久必合，合久必分……」
一直写了一回目，洋洋洒洒几千字，耗费一个多时辰，足足写了十几张，写完一张传递出去，自翰墨斋老者之手，不大一会儿，围观三五人互为传阅，倒也不枯燥。
啧啧称叹之声，就是不绝于耳。
有赞字儿锋锐毕露的，有说词旷达写意的，还有感慨情节开局雄浑的。
「好一个桃园三结义！风云际会，君臣知遇，让人悠然神往。」表字文度的蓝袍青年，击节而赞道。
贾珩则是搁了笔，捏了捏发酸的手腕，暗道，这种抄写之法，当真不是一般的累。
那老者笑道：「公子当真是出人意表啊，还未请教公子名姓？」
贾珩拱手道：「在下贾珩。」
「姓贾？」青衫公子韩晖，看向表字文度的青年，低声道：「于兄，姓贾，莫非是？」
于缜点了点头道：「这京中姓贾的，除了那条街上的，好像也没别地儿了。」
这就是宁荣二公在大汉神京的排面，两府八房，凡是京中贾姓，十之七八皆为贾家旁支子弟。
老者眸中异色一闪，心头也有猜测，就是招呼夥计送了一盏香茶给贾珩，沉吟道：「贾公子这书稿，后续还有多少回目？」
贾珩吃了一口茶，情知老者已然动心，笑道：「凡百二十回。」

老者一时默然，而后笑道：「还请公子借一步说话。」
说着，让人收拾，然后拿着一沓文稿，向着二楼而去。
贾珩点了点头，放下茶盏，随着老者向二楼而去。
这边厢，韩晖和于缜对视一眼，韩晖笑道：「等这位贾兄谈完事情，我们再过去。」
于缜皱眉道：「贾家门楣高，子弟向来眼高于顶，只怕不好结交。」
韩晖笑道：「文度兄，你看这位贾兄的装扮，像是荣宁二府出来的？」
于缜面色恍然，道：「原来如此。」
「当年荣宁二公在京中八房，几代下来，多有远亲，于宁荣二府几如邻里街坊无异，这位贾珩兄若真是二府出来的，也不会手头拮据到在此沽文换银了。」
于缜笑道：「韩兄所言在理。」
不提二人对贾珩身份的揣测，贾珩跟着老者进入二楼，二楼仍是列着一排排书柜，只是临窗之地，有一雅舍，老者当先而入，笑道：「贾公子，请。」
宾主落座。
贾珩拱了拱手，道：「老先生客气了。」
老者笑道：「老朽刘通，贾公子唤我一声刘掌柜即可。」
贾珩客气道了一声不敢，唤了一声刘老先生。
刘通道：「老朽冒昧，贾公子可是宁荣街过来的？」
贾珩点了点头，道：「刘老先生慧眼，珩为宁国之后。」
老者惊讶道：「原来是宁公之后，怪不得能写出这般金戈铁马丶气象开阔的雄文，方才倒是失敬了。」
贾珩轻笑了下，说道：「珩这一脉，并非宁国长房嫡脉，否则，也不会到老先生这里来了。」
刘通笑道：「可公子身上流的还不是宁国公的血？」
贾珩面色微顿，心头也是一叹，这就是让人无语之处了。

无论他来日做什麽，科举从军也好，为官作宰也罢，世人眼中都会天然地将他和贾家联系在一起。
刘通笑道：「贾公子，这画本不错，可是三国之事，画本戏曲丶评书大鼓也不是没有，恐无法收新奇耳目之效。」
接下来就是正式谈生意的流程，这位刘通掌柜一开口就是先说书稿不够新奇，方便下一步压价。

content_en:
Jia Heng bowed his hands towards the old man and said, "Please, sir."
The old man was dressed in a silk shirt, with gray hair and strong cheeks. He nodded slightly to Jia Heng and asked with some scrutiny in his old eyes, "Young master, do you want to sell the manuscript?"
Jia Heng smiled and said, "I just came here to ask. If the old gentleman doesn't like it, just treat it as a temporary joke."
The old man twirled his beard under his chin, smiled, and said, "I don't know what manuscript it is. Can you take a look at it?"
His master liked these story and picture books the most, and repeatedly told him that if there were any new story books, he must show them to her.
Jia Heng's face paused, a little embarrassed, and said, "I haven't written this out yet."
The old man's face looked a little strange, and he looked a little worried, and said calmly: "Is this young master just looking for entertainment for this old man?"
Jia Heng said: "Mr. Haihan, it is true that the manuscript has not been written yet, but the story has already been mastered. I hope you have a pen and paper here. Please wait for a while and write a chapter for me to review."
When the old man saw this, he was stunned by Jia Heng's serious look. He couldn't help but laugh and said, "Young Master is really a wonderful man."
He told the waiter on the side: "Go find some paper and pen."
The guy responded and quickly took the order.
The old man smiled and said, "I've heard that Cao Zijian wrote a poem in seven steps. Is this how you imitate the ancients?"
This Hanmo Studio was originally opened by the owner to facilitate the collection of ancient books. He was just here to read books, but he hadn't met such an interesting young man in a long time.
Jia Heng smiled and said, "I don't dare to compare with the ancients' talents, but I did not deceive the old man just now. I already have a good grasp of the manuscript."
Think about those authors who wrote online articles in the past life. They could write thousands of words an hour, and they were really able to write something eloquently.
Not long after, the guy came over with pen and paper.
At this time, some young scholars who were buying books had arrived in Hanmo Zhai in twos and threes. When they heard the movement, they gathered around to watch.
One of the young men in straight blue robes, who was in his early twenties, had an elegant face and warm eyes. He held a folding fan in his hand and a jade pendant hanging on his waist. He looked at this scene curiously and whispered to the tall, square-faced young man in blue robes beside him: "Brother Wendu, does this brother want to write a poem? I don't want to do such an elegant thing, but we met in the Hanmo Studio."
These two people were supervisors of Shenjing Imperial College. They had no classes today, so they went to the Hanmo Studio to hang out and prepare to buy some pens, inks, paper and inkstones.
Over here, Jia Heng thanked the clerk, took the pen and paper, dipped ink in the inkstone, spread out the paper as white as snow, and started writing.
He originally wanted to write about the Condor Shooting, but the rhetoric of the Condor Shooting was a common vernacular of later generations, and he was afraid that it would be difficult to reach the elegant hall and attract criticism, especially when some scholars gradually gathered around Zhou Fang, so he rewrote the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
"The rolling Yangtze River flows eastward, and the waves wash away the heroes..."
Therefore, the history of this world is somewhat different from that of China in the previous life. Yang Shen in the Ming Dynasty did exist. During the Jiajing period of the previous Ming Dynasty, there was also a dispute over great etiquette.
However, Yang Shen's fate was different from his previous life. He was not exiled to Yunnan. This Linjiang Immortal has never appeared. Of course, even if it had appeared, there is nothing wrong with quoting other people's poems in the book.
But when Linjiang Immortal came out, everyone who was watching was surprised.
"This Que Linjiang Immortal is really generous, tragic, and soul-stirring. It seems like a new word? And this word is broad and broad, and the pen is sharp, like a sword and axe, and a silver hook on an iron painting... He is really very skilled." The young man with a literary character looked at the young man in green shirt beside him and asked in a low voice: "Brother Han, you have a lot of friends, do you know who this brother is?"
The young man in green shirt shook his head, with a look of surprise on his face, and whispered: "I'm also nervous when I look at it, I'll ask you later."That’s it. "
Jia Heng wrote Linjiang Xian in regular regular script, with smooth strokes, and suddenly, after Linjiang Xian's calligraphy was written, he began to write "The general trend of the world, if it divides for a long time, it will unite, if it unites for a long time, it will unite..."
I have been writing for a while, thousands of words eloquently, it took more than an hour, and I wrote more than a dozen sheets. After writing one sheet, I passed it out. It came from the hands of the old man in the Hanmo Studio. After a while, three or five people onlookers circulated it to each other, which was not boring.
The sounds of tutting and sighing are endless.
There are some that praise the poem with sharp and sharp words, some that are broad-minded and freehand, and some that lament the powerful start of the plot.
"What a peach orchard sworn brotherhood! The meeting between the emperor and his ministers makes people feel relaxed and fascinated." The young man in blue robe, who expressed his elegant character, praised the knot.
Jia Heng put down his pen, squeezed his sore wrist, and said to himself, this kind of copying method is really not that tiring.
The old man smiled and said, "Young Master is really unexpected. You haven't asked for your first name yet?"
Jia Heng cupped his hands and said, "Jia Heng."
"Your surname is Jia?" Han Hui, the young man in green shirt, looked at the young man named Wendu and whispered: "Brother Yu, your surname is Jia, is that it?"
Yu Zhen nodded and said, "There seems to be no other place in the capital except on that street for people with the surname Jia."
This is the appearance of the second Duke Ning Rong in the capital of the Han Dynasty. There are two houses and eight houses. All the people with the Jia surname in the capital are likely to be descendants of the Jia family.
A strange color flashed in the old man's eyes, and he also had a guess in his mind. He asked the waiter to bring a cup of fragrant tea to Jia Heng, and said thoughtfully: "How many times will the manuscript of Mr. Jia be read in the future?"
Jia Heng took a sip of tea and knew that the old man was already attracted. He smiled and said, "One hundred and twenty times."
The old man was silent for a moment, then smiled and said, "Please give me a chance to speak, sir."
With that said, he asked people to pack it up, then took a stack of manuscripts and headed towards the second floor.
Jia Heng nodded, put down the tea cup, and followed the old man to the second floor.
Over here, Han Hui and Yu Zhen looked at each other. Han Hui smiled and said, "We'll go there after Brother Jia has finished talking about things."
Yu Zhen frowned and said, "The Jia family has a high lintel, and the children have always set their sights higher than the top. I'm afraid it's hard to make friends."
Han Hui smiled and said, "Brother Wendu, do you think this brother Jia is dressed like he came from the Rongning Second Mansion?"
Yu Zhen's face suddenly became clear and he said, "That's it."
"Back then, the second Duke Rong Ning lived in the eighth house in the capital. Over the generations, he had many distant relatives. He and Ning Rong were almost like neighbors. If this brother Jia Heng really came from the second house, he wouldn't be so strapped for money that he would trade money here for money."
Yu Zhen smiled and said, "What Brother Han said makes sense."
Regardless of the two's speculations about Jia Heng's identity, Jia Heng followed the old man into the second floor. There were still rows of bookcases on the second floor, but there was an elegant house near the window. The old man entered first and said with a smile: "Master Jia, please."
The guests and hosts took their seats.
Jia Heng cupped his hands and said, "You're welcome, sir."
The old man smiled and said: "Old Liu Tong, Mr. Jia just call me Shopkeeper Liu."
Jia Heng said politely that he didn't dare, and called Mr. Liu.
Liu Tongtong: "I'm taking the liberty of saying, Mr. Jia, is he from Ningrong Street?"
Jia Heng nodded and said, "Mr. Liu has a keen eye and Heng is the Queen of Ning State."
The old man was surprised and said: "It turns out that he was the queen of Ning Gong. No wonder he could write such heroic and open-minded articles. It was disrespectful just now."
Jia Heng chuckled lightly and said, "Heng's lineage is not the direct lineage of Ning Guo's Changfang, otherwise, he would not have come to the old gentleman."
Liu Tong smiled and said, "But the blood flowing on your body is not Ning Guogong's blood?"
Jia Heng's face paused slightly, and he sighed in his heart. This is what makes people speechless.
No matter what he does in the future, whether he takes the imperial examination, joins the army, or becomes an official, he will be naturally linked to the Jia family in the eyes of the world.
Liu Tong smiled and said: "Master Jia, this painting is good, but the story of the Three Kingdoms, the painting, opera, storytelling and drums are also not without, I may not be able to have a novel effect."
Take itThis was the formal business negotiation process. Shopkeeper Liu Tong started by saying that the manuscript was not novel enough, so that he could lower the price in the next step.
